name: Integration Nightly

on:
  schedule:
    # Run at 00:00 UTC every day
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_community_tests:
        description: 'Run community repo tests'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true
      run_eas_builds:
        description: 'Run EAS builds (expensive)'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

jobs:
  # Job 1: Generate the dynamic matrix for the 253 deduplicated configs
  generate-matrix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'yarn'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate Nightly Matrix
        id: matrix
        run: |
          # Generate the 253 deduplicated configs for nightly run
          MATRIX_JSON=$(node integration-tests/matrix-generator.ts nightly)
          echo "matrix=$MATRIX_JSON" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Debug Matrix
        run: echo ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.matrix }}

  # Job 2: Run the integration tests against the generated matrix
  integration-tests:
    needs: generate-matrix
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: ${{ fromJson(needs.generate-matrix.outputs.matrix) }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'yarn'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run Single Integration Test
        run: |
          # Execute the specific config defined in the matrix
          node integration-tests/run-single.ts \
            --config-name "${{ matrix.configName }}" \
            --package-manager "${{ matrix.packageManager }}" \
            --fixture-dir "fixtures/${{ matrix.packageManager }}-app"

  # Job 3: Run Community Repo Tests (Optional, based on dispatch input)
  community-tests:
    needs: integration-tests
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.run_community_tests == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'yarn'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run Community Tests
        run: |
          node integration-tests/community-runner.ts

  # Job 4: Run EAS Builds (Optional, based on dispatch input)
  eas-builds:
    needs: integration-tests
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.run_eas_builds == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        platform: [android, ios]
        variant: [development, preview, release]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'yarn'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Setup EAS
        uses: expo/expo-github-action@v8
        with:
          eas-version: latest
          token: ${{ secrets.EXPO_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build on EAS
        run: |
          eas build --platform ${{ matrix.platform }} --profile ${{ matrix.variant }} --non-interactive

  # Job 5: Check if all jobs passed
  check-all-green:
    needs:
      - integration-tests
      - community-tests
      - eas-builds
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check if all jobs passed
        uses: re-actors/alls-green@release/v1
        with:
          jobs: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}

  # Job 6: Notify Slack (Optional, if webhook is configured)
  notify-slack:
    needs: check-all-green
    if: always() && needs.check-all-green.result == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Notify Slack
        uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
        with:
          webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          status: success
          message: "Nightly Integration Tests Passed"
        if: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL != '' }}
